_comment: aws ecs run-task --cli-input-json file://ops/migrations/migrate-task.json (substitute <cluster>, <task-definition>, <subnet-ids>, <security-group-id> from `terraform output` before every rolling deploy - deploy.md step 3/4). Runs db/migrate.js against the api image so it never drifts from the code being deployed. Postgres advisory lock in db/migrate.js makes a concurrent run a no-op rather than a corruption.
